opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for flights from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date} (and optional {return_date}) for {passengers}, optionally applying a promo code and selecting the outbound/return fares.
steps: Open ryanair.com Flights tab
Choose Return trip or One way
Click From field, pick origin country then origin airport
Click To field, pick destination country then destination airport
Open the depart calendar, navigate to the month and click the depart date
If return trip, click the return date
Open Passengers and set the number of adults (and others), click Done
Optionally click Apply promo code and enter it
Click Search
On results, click Select on the outbound flight
Click Select on the return flight

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search {destination/attraction} for {date}, optionally filter and sort, open an attraction, choose date/time and set ticket quantities, then click Next.
steps: Click the Attractions tab
Type the destination or attraction (or pick a destination tile) and pick the suggestion
Click Select your dates and choose the date
Click Search
Optionally apply filters (free cancellation, city, category) and sort order (e.g. Most popular)
Click the chosen attraction / See availability
Choose the date or time slot
Set adult/child/infant ticket counts
Click Next
